limitations: One researcher account in one project on one cluster per App instance. Labmates, the lab head and the cluster are not accounts: what they do arrives as events.
The cluster is not simulated. Benchline runs no code and has no scheduler. What a job does comes from task-supplied run plans, which no Agent operation returns.
One current allocation period. The period does not close by itself, and a new period is loaded as history with env.load_seed.
No files, logs, checkpoints, artifacts, job arrays, job dependencies, sweeps, priorities, fair-share scores or node inventory.
MCP only: no GUI and no console for the lab head.
The App has no timer. Job starts and ends, expired protocol versions and the release of notifications are computed from the supplied virtual time.
No images or attachments: resources are not used.
Email is the only notification channel. Notifications reach Mail only through the Infra-run sender and Messaging. The App itself delivers nothing.
